description: This file is a JSON Schema representing the System API interface for a device management system. It defines API methods, events, data models, and documentation for system-level features such as firmware updates, device info, power and mode settings, and event callbacks.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, firmware version, etc. (Deprecated from single call, use specific methods).

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Returns current and downloaded firmware version details.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Provides the progress percentage of the ongoing firmware download.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks for available firmware updates.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Provides the reason for the last firmware update failure.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the last wakeup key.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves various MAC addresses (Ethernet, Wifi, Bluetooth, etc.) of the device.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing serial number of the device.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Indicates whether WakeOnLAN/WLAN standby is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Returns device support features and account info.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns the current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Retrieves the device power state prior to a reboot.

methods.name: getRFCConfig
methods.description: Gets RDK feature control configuration parameters.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device's serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Gets system version details including firmware and receiver versions.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves the device's friendly name.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Gets the system's territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Lists available system time zones.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Gets configured system time zone and DST info.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for waking up from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry data opt-out is enabled.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests a device reboot with specified reason.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns the device uptime.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets the duration for deep sleep timeout.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic firmware reboot after download.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the system mode (NORMAL, EAS, WAREHOUSE) for a specified duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby support (legacy API).

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets the telemetry data opt-out flag.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the device power state and optional standby reason.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the device friendly name.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures or updates the splash screen shown during boot.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns build type of the current firmware image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets the system territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Sets system time zone and DST configuration.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Configures wakeup sources; deprecated, migrate to supported API.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Starts firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Uploads device logs asynchronously.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops ongoing log upload.
